scope: Turkish text for MKAOS training, validation, independent testing, and potential model-weight redistribution
policy: A candidate is not approved until exact release, files, hashes, license scope, attribution, privacy and model-training/weight-distribution terms receive documented human review.

sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice sentence text
sources.license_claim: Repository states most sentence text in server/data is CC0; release-specific scope must be verified.
review_required: pin exact dataset release and Turkish subset
verify license covers exact text files
record SHA-256 for each source archive/file
exclude audio unless separately licensed and reviewed
human review of content and privacy
sources.evidence_note: Repository-level description is not proof of the terms for every released Turkish file or any audio/derived model weights.

sources.name: Turkish Wikipedia / Wikimedia text
sources.license_claim: Wikimedia text commonly carries CC BY-SA 4.0 and/or GFDL obligations, with source/page exceptions.
review_required: review exact dump and imported-content exceptions
assess training and model-weight distribution obligations

sources.name: Tatoeba Turkish text sentences
sources.license_claim: Text generally CC BY 2.0 FR with attribution; sentence-level exceptions and audio terms differ.
review_required: pin exact export and Turkish rows
retain sentence-author attribution for every record
sources.evidence_note: Do not assume the CC0 language subset includes Turkish.
